audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields attribute Vladimir's healing to 'Crimson Rush'. No such ability exists. Crimson Pact is his passive (AP/HP conversion, no healing); the healing you are burning through is Transfusion (Q), with Hemoplague (R) healing him per champion hit.
audit.why: Naming the wrong source sends the reader watching the wrong bar. Transfusion is the ability that heals, and it is a 9 s cooldown at rank 1 dropping to 4.6 s maxed — that is what anti-heal is timed against.
audit.corrected: 'Crimson Rush' replaced with Transfusion (and Hemoplague where the R heal is meant) in spikes[2].text, whys[5] and wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2, 3 and First item are given to Vladimir, but the packet chart reads Skill at Level 2, Swain at Level 3 and Swain at First item — and the whys for rows 2 and 5 explicitly call them Swain's ownership windows.
audit.why: The chart contradicted its own explanations and the 51.46% win rate over 309 games.
audit.corrected: Row 1 to Skill, rows 2 and 5 to Swain with ratings raised to 7/10; win[] and phases[].side proposed as pairs.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Level 3 full pattern, Level 6 duelling ultimates, Liandry's, and full-AP Vladimir. Both ultimates are 120 s, so the level-6 row is genuinely a mutual spike.

Both flagged missing interactions are already covered: the untargetable Sanguine Pool dodging your commit is stated across whys[1], mid and late, and anti-heal is in the itemization line. Only the cooldown number was absent, now added.
audit.corrected: Sanguine Pool named at its rank-1 28 s cooldown so the bait-and-count is concrete.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment on completion — your W poke now burns continuously through his Crimson Rush healing, making every trade punishing.
edits.after: Liandry's Torment on completion — your W poke burns through his Transfusion healing, and anti-heal makes every trade punishing.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment burning through his Crimson Rush healing makes every W poke a punishing tick-damage trade he cannot simply Q-heal back.
edits.after: Liandry's Torment burning through his Transfusion healing makes every W poke a punishing tick-damage trade he cannot simply Q-heal back.

edits.before: Force extended drain-fights with Demonic Ascension active so his Crimson Rush healing cannot out-sustain your R regeneration
edits.after: Force extended drain-fights with Demonic Ascension active so his Transfusion and Hemoplague healing cannot out-sustain your R

edits.before: E-root is online but Sanguine Pool answers it cleanly — only commit the root when you have confirmed his W is on cooldown, then drag the fragment.
edits.after: E-root is online but Sanguine Pool answers it cleanly — and at rank 1 that pool is down 28 s, so bait it, count it out, then root and drag the fragment.

notes: Fabricated ability 'Crimson Rush' removed from three fields — Vladimir's passive is Crimson Pact and it does not heal; the healing is Transfusion (Q) and Hemoplague (R). Chart rows 1, 2 and 5 flipped to match packet.levelChart, proposed as matched win[]/phases[].side pairs.
